addr: 39, 8th Main Rd, 4th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560034, India

rev.t: A quiet, slick coffee shop in between the crowds of Koramangla. They have great coffee, and now amazing pizza by Trippy Goat as well. For a change, I tried the matcha float (like coke float) and it was delightful. Highly recommend!

Amazing food.The flavors in each dish were perfectly balanced, and the ingredients tasted incredibly fresh. Loved the Cold brew a lot. However I don't like the butter paper behind the sandwich since it gets mixed up with the food which is not ok.

Brat spot!
I absolutely loved the vibe and energy of this place. On top of the great atmosphere, the food was super tasty and full of flavor. Fantastic experience all around, much recommended.
